---
title: "C++ Node Package"
---

A ROS 2 C++ package contains the compiled nodes that perform control,
estimation, state machines, and any other compute-intensive logic. This page
covers the minimal boilerplate to get a node building under colcon inside a
pixi workspace.

---

## Directory layout

```
src/
+-- my_pkg/
    +-- include/
    |   +-- my_pkg/
    |       +-- controller.hpp
    |       +-- estimator.hpp
    +-- src/
    |   +-- controller.cpp
    |   +-- estimator.cpp
    |   +-- main.cpp
    +-- launch/
    |   +-- node.launch.py          # minimal single-node launch
    +-- CMakeLists.txt
    +-- package.xml
```

Headers live under `include/<package_name>/` so they resolve as
`#include "my_pkg/controller.hpp"` from any downstream package.

---

## package.xml

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<?xml-model href="http://download.ros.org/schema/package_format3.xsd"
            schematypens="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"?>
<package format="3">
  <name>my_pkg</name>
  <version>0.1.0</version>
  <description>Control and estimation nodes</description>
  <maintainer email="you@example.com">Your Name</maintainer>
  <license>MIT</license>

  <buildtool_depend>ament_cmake</buildtool_depend>

  <!-- runtime + build: use <depend> for packages needed at both stages -->
  <depend>rclcpp</depend>
  <depend>rclcpp_components</depend>
  <depend>std_msgs</depend>
  <depend>geometry_msgs</depend>
  <depend>nav_msgs</depend>
  <depend>px4_msgs</depend>

  <export>
    <build_type>ament_cmake</build_type>
  </export>
</package>
```

Use `<depend>` (not `<build_depend>` + `<exec_depend>`) for libraries needed
at both build and runtime — which covers most ROS packages.

---

## CMakeLists.txt

```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(my_pkg)

if(CMAKE_COMPILER_IS_GNUCXX OR CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

# --- dependencies ---
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp_components REQUIRED)
find_package(std_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nav_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(px4_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)

# --- shared library (enables composable-node registration) ---
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED
  src/controller.cpp
  src/estimator.cpp
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  ${EIGEN3_INCLUDE_DIR}
)

target_compile_features(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

ament_target_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME}
  rclcpp
  rclcpp_components
  std_msgs
  geometry_msgs
  nav_msgs
  px4_msgs
)

# --- register composable nodes ---
rclcpp_components_register_node(${PROJECT_NAME}
  PLUGIN "my_pkg::Controller"
  EXECUTABLE controller_node
)

rclcpp_components_register_node(${PROJECT_NAME}
  PLUGIN "my_pkg::Estimator"
  EXECUTABLE estimator_node
)

# --- install ---
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME}
  ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
  LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
  RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
)

install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY launch   DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
```

::: {.callout-note}
Building as a shared library and using `rclcpp_components_register_node`
lets the bringup package load nodes in a `ComponentContainer` without
spawning separate processes. The `EXECUTABLE` argument also produces a
standalone binary for direct `ros2 run` use.
:::

## Node boilerplate (C++)

### Header — `include/my_pkg/controller.hpp`

```cpp
#pragma once

#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>
#include <geometry_msgs/msg/pose_stamped.hpp>
#include <px4_msgs/msg/vehicle_odometry.hpp>
#include <px4_msgs/msg/trajectory_setpoint.hpp>

namespace my_pkg {

class Controller : public rclcpp::Node {
public:
    explicit Controller(const rclcpp::NodeOptions& options = rclcpp::NodeOptions());

private:
    void odom_callback(const px4_msgs::msg::VehicleOdometry::SharedPtr msg);
    void setpoint_callback(const geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped::SharedPtr msg);

    rclcpp::Subscription<px4_msgs::msg::VehicleOdometry>::SharedPtr odom_sub_;
    rclcpp::Subscription<geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped>::SharedPtr setpoint_sub_;
    rclcpp::Publisher<px4_msgs::msg::TrajectorySetpoint>::SharedPtr cmd_pub_;
    rclcpp::TimerBase::SharedPtr timer_;
};

}  // namespace my_pkg
```

### Implementation — `src/controller.cpp`

```cpp
#include "my_pkg/controller.hpp"
#include <rclcpp/qos.hpp>

namespace my_pkg {

Controller::Controller(const rclcpp::NodeOptions& options)
: Node("controller", options)
{
    /* PX4 uORB topics require BEST_EFFORT QoS -- see QoS Profiles page. */
    auto px4_qos = rclcpp::QoS(10).best_effort();

    odom_sub_ = create_subscription<px4_msgs::msg::VehicleOdometry>(
        "/fmu/out/vehicle_odometry", px4_qos,
        [this](const px4_msgs::msg::VehicleOdometry::SharedPtr msg) {
            odom_callback(msg);
        });

    setpoint_sub_ = create_subscription<geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped>(
        "~/setpoint", rclcpp::QoS(1),
        [this](const geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped::SharedPtr msg) {
            setpoint_callback(msg);
        });

    cmd_pub_ = create_publisher<px4_msgs::msg::TrajectorySetpoint>(
        "/fmu/in/trajectory_setpoint", px4_qos);

    /* declare parameters with defaults */
    declare_parameter("control_rate_hz", 50.0);
    double rate = get_parameter("control_rate_hz").as_double();

    timer_ = create_wall_timer(
        std::chrono::duration<double>(1.0 / rate),
        [this]() { /* run control loop */ });
}

void Controller::odom_callback(const px4_msgs::msg::VehicleOdometry::SharedPtr msg)
{
    RCLCPP_INFO_THROTTLE(get_logger(), *get_clock(), 1000,
        "pos: [%.2f, %.2f, %.2f]",
        msg->position[0], msg->position[1], msg->position[2]);
}

void Controller::setpoint_callback(const geometry_msgs::msg::PoseStamped::SharedPtr /*msg*/)
{
    /* store latest goal */
}

}  // namespace my_pkg

/* composable-node entry point (used by ComponentContainer) */
#include "rclcpp_components/register_node_macro.hpp"
RCLCPP_COMPONENTS_REGISTER_NODE(my_pkg::Controller)
```

### Standalone entry point — `src/main.cpp`

```cpp
#include <rclcpp/rclcpp.hpp>
#include "my_pkg/controller.hpp"

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
    rclcpp::init(argc, argv);
    rclcpp::spin(std::make_shared<my_pkg::Controller>());
    rclcpp::shutdown();
    return 0;
}
```

## Minimal launch file

This launch file lives in the node package itself and is only used for
quick manual testing. For full system bringup see the
[Bringup Package](ros2-bringup-package.qmd) page.

**`launch/node.launch.py`**:

```python
from launch import LaunchDescription
from launch_ros.actions import Node


def generate_launch_description():
    return LaunchDescription([
        Node(
            package="my_pkg",
            executable="controller_node",
            name="controller",
            output="screen",
        ),
    ])
```

---

## Building and running

```bash
# build all packages under src/
pixi run build

# standalone binary
pixi run -- ros2 run my_pkg controller_node

# or via launch file
pixi run -- ros2 launch my_pkg node.launch.py
```

After editing source files re-run `pixi run build`. Python and resource
files installed with `--symlink-install` update without a rebuild; C++ sources
always require a rebuild.

---

## Adding a new node

1. Add the header under `include/my_pkg/`.
2. Add the source file under `src/`.
3. Register it in `CMakeLists.txt` with `rclcpp_components_register_node`.
4. Run `pixi run build`.
